newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Coupons rise on Saudi two- to five-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Coupons rise on Saudi two- to five-year bonds.

text.p: Coupons rose on Saudi government bonds worth 1.5 billion riyals on Saturday, a banker said. The bonds are offered to Saudi-based banks every two weeks by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency on a Saturday.

The annual coupon for two years climbed to 6.04 percent from 5.89 percent two weeks ago, three years climbed to 6.23 percent from 6.05 percent, four years rose to 6.37 percent from 6.17 percent and five years to 6.56 percent from 6.34 percent.
The rates are fixed at 30 basis points above the comparable U.S. note for two years, 35 points for three years, 40 points for four years and 50 points for five years.
